scope: Every shipped PNG/WebP in public; original source files are never modified. Existing lossy inputs are compared against their current decoded pixels, not against an unavailable earlier master.
policy: No resize, chroma subsampling, near-lossless encoding, quantization, bit-depth reduction, alpha premultiplication, or invisible-RGB changes. AVIF accepted only with identical full straight decoded RGBA and equivalent dimensions/color-profile/orientation/animation semantics. Candidate selection and browser decoding are separate approvals.
method: Sharp lossless AVIF, 4:4:4, 8 bit, effort4 for every image. If exact comparison fails, installed avifenc lossless identity/GBR CICP1/13/0 full-range 4:4:4 speed6 jobs1 is tested via independently exact PNG transport. Single-image pages/pageHeight shape is normalized semantically.
